transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

Probably not broken. Many ovens run a separate cooling fan after switch-off to cool the controls and surrounding cabinet; 10–30 minutes is quite normal, especially after a hot or long cook. Leave it switched off and let it cool naturally. If the fan stops once the oven is cold, that is normal behaviour. It needs attention if it carries on for hours or still runs when the oven is completely cold. In that case the cooling-fan thermostat/control may be sticking and an engineer should check it. If the control panel or surrounding cupboards become unusually hot, stop using the oven until it is inspected.

candidates: Cooling-fan control/thermostat fault if it continues from cold (low)

reading.symptom: fan keeps running after the oven is turned off for about 20 minutes

plan: They asked: "Is it broken?" - answer that first.
The fault they reported is: "fan keeps running after the oven is turned off for about 20 minutes". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the safe checks that best tell those causes apart (most useful and simplest first, usually two to four), each with why it helps and what each result would mean; or, if one question would settle it sooner, ask that. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
